verdict.rationale: Dagster's code-first asset model (Python functions define assets) and its integration library (dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt) show it can orchestrate loads across varied systems without rewriting pipeline logic, supporting portability across data platforms. However, the evidence pack never names direct Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, or object-storage IO managers/connectors, so the core warehouse/lake-portability claim is only indirectly supported via generic ELT tool integrations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks/Postgres/object-storage IO managers, evidence of swapping resources/configs to retarget the same pipeline across these systems, and independent confirmation of this portability in practice.
